papers.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Latent Reasoning framework in Continuous space (LARC), which alleviates the token-level bottleneck by reasoning over continuous hidden states. Specifically, the training framework consists of two stages: (i) curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (ii) information-gain reinforcement learning (RL). First, the curriculum SFT stage gradually converts token-level reasoning into latent reasoning. Subsequently, the information-gain RL stage self-evolves latent reasoning without ground truth supervision. Experiments across diverse text-to-image generation benchmarks show that LARC consistently improves generation quality, prompt following, and compositional fidelity. Notably, LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL and demonstrates clear test-time scaling behavior, outperforming token-based generation under both parallel and sequential test-time scaling strategies.

ai_summary.problem: 统一多模态模型在图像生成中难以有效利用语言链式推理，导致无法继承大语言模型中的测试时扩展和细粒度可控性。
ai_summary.method: 提出连续空间潜在推理框架 LARC，用连续隐藏状态替代离散 token 进行推理；训练分为课程式监督微调和信息增益强化学习两阶段，先逐步将 token 级推理转化为潜在推理，再在无真值监督下自演化。
ai_summary.result: 在多种文本到图像生成基准上，LARC 持续提升生成质量、提示跟随和组合保真度；在 GenEval 上比 BAGEL 高 7 个百分点，并展现出明确的测试时扩展行为。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将多模态推理从离散 token 空间迁移到连续潜在空间，以缓解推理与图像生成之间的模态不匹配。
ai_summary.relevance: 为统一多模态模型中的推理增强与测试时扩展提供了新方向，有望推动更可控、更可扩展的多模态生成。
ai_summary.org: POSTECH 和 KAIST

papers.title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
papers.abstract: Planning with world models enables test-time adaptation for embodied agents, offering superior generalization over direct policy learning. However, long-horizon tasks remain hindered by cumulative errors and search complexity. Existing hierarchical methods often use rigid macro-actions or latent skills, leading to brittle representations and limited fine-grained control. We introduce ID-WM (Implicit Dynamics World Models), a hierarchical world model that decouples state-space reachability from local control. Our framework utilizes a high-level model to sample feasible transitions across the state manifold and a low-level world model as an inverse dynamics solver to ground these transitions into precise actions. This allows the planner to identify reachable subgoals without being constrained by low-level execution details. By prioritizing local physical feasibility over global behavioral patterns, ID-WM synthesizes novel long-horizon plans from short segments, transcending the specific behavioral modes seen during training. We demonstrate its effectiveness across three navigation and manipulation suites, achieving a 38.5% improvement over state-of-the-art policy and diffusion-based planners. Crucially, by leveraging this hierarchical structure to mitigate compounding errors, our approach yields a 135% performance gain over single-level world model MPC, particularly in complex, unseen configurations for long-horizon tasks. Videos can be viewed at https://id-wm.github.io

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型规划在长时程任务中受累积误差和搜索复杂度限制，现有分层方法使用刚性宏动作或潜在技能，导致表示脆弱且缺乏细粒度控制。
ai_summary.method: 提出ID-WM分层世界模型，将状态空间可达性与局部控制解耦：高层模型采样状态流形上的可行转移，低层世界模型作为逆动力学求解器将转移落地为精确动作，使规划器不受低层执行细节约束。
ai_summary.result: 在三个导航与操作套件上比SOTA策略和扩散规划器提升38.5%，相比单层世界模型MPC在复杂未见长时程配置中提升135%。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过隐式动力学解耦可达子目标与动作生成，从短片段合成新颖长时程计划并缓解复合误差。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型中的长时程分层规划与具身智能提供了更可扩展且物理可行的范式。

papers.title: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) learn latent variables from observations and use these to both predict the evolution of the scene and to generate actions. The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions. WAMs fitted to demonstrations do not, in general, guarantee that they will generate actions solely from the latent causes of the demonstrated actions (the action-relevant latent variables), as the model could just as well learn to imitate in this way whilst entangling the action-relevant latent variables with the nuisance variables. We therefore separate out what causes action from what prediction depends on. We prove that under a sparsity constraint the latent variables used to generate actions are an invertible function of the action-relevant latent variables alone and the true structure is identified up to a permutation of the latent variables. This requires neither sufficient temporal dependence nor any assumptions on how the unobserved regimes evolve and holds even when the action-relevant latent variables are statistically dependent on the rest. We therefore propose CWAM (Causal WAM), which incorporates the constraint into a pretrained WAM by adding a sparse routing path to its action head, with the world modeling objective remaining unchanged. Experiments on both synthetic data and real-world robots validate the theory as well as showcase the improved efficiency in closed-loop success.

ai_summary.problem: 世界动作模型（WAMs）从观测中学习潜变量来预测场景并生成动作，但动作只由场景中的一部分因素导致；模型容易将动作相关潜变量与无关干扰变量纠缠，无法保证仅基于动作的原因生成动作。
ai_summary.method: 论文将“导致动作的因素”与“预测所依赖的因素”分离，证明在稀疏约束下，用于生成动作的潜变量是动作相关潜变量的可逆函数，且真实结构可识别到潜变量置换；据此提出 CWAM，在预训练 WAM 的动作头上加入稀疏路由路径，同时保持世界建模目标不变。
ai_summary.result: 合成数据和真实机器人实验验证了理论，并展示了在闭环任务成功率/效率上的提升。
ai_summary.novelty: 为世界动作模型中的动作相关潜变量提供可识别性理论，并通过稀疏路由在预训练 WAM 中实现因果解耦。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于提升具身智能和世界模型中动作生成的因果性、鲁棒性与闭环效率。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未在元数据中提供；Henrik I. Christensen 通常隶属 UC San Diego，推测主要来自加州大学圣地亚哥分校等。

papers.title: Movens-Zero: Scaling Humanoid Motion Foundation Models with Large-Scale Human Videos
papers.abstract: Scaling humanoid motion foundation models is constrained by the scarcity of diverse, robot-executable data and by the difficulty of jointly learning from heterogeneous multimodal inputs while supporting real-time closed-loop control. We present Movens-5M, constructed from raw Internet videos through clip generation, quality filtering, semantic annotation, motion recovery, and physical refinement with humanoid retargeting and execution verification. It contains 15 million human-motion sequences and 5 million physically executable humanoid-motion sequences spanning over 10,000 hours, aligned with text, RGB video, speech, and music. Building on this data, we introduce Movens-Zero, a scalable understanding-generation-execution architecture that supports joint learning across modalities and real-time closed-loop execution. Task-mixed flow-matching training jointly optimizes a single action expert across seven generation tasks, enabling direct motion generation from text, speech, music, and video. Multimodal Real-Time Chunking connects overlapping chunks under continuously updated instructions and robot states for continuous closed-loop execution. We further introduce Movens-Intent, a four-track benchmark with 8,192 expert-verified condition-motion pairs across text, speech, music, and video. Experiments show consistent gains across all four modalities when scaling execution-verified data from 1% to 100% and action-expert capacity from 64M to 911M parameters, while demonstrating that data quality and cross-modal supervision improve generation and execution.

ai_summary.problem: 人形运动基础模型受限于多样且机器人可执行数据稀缺，以及难以从异构多模态输入中联合学习并支持实时闭环控制。
ai_summary.method: 构建 Movens-5M 大规模数据集，从互联网视频经片段生成、质量过滤、语义标注、运动恢复和物理细化得到1500万人类运动序列与500万人形可执行运动序列；提出 Movens-Zero 理解-生成-执行架构，用任务混合流匹配训练单一动作专家支持文本、语音、音乐、视频生成运动，并用多模态实时分块实现连续闭环执行；同时提出 Movens-Intent 基准。
ai_summary.result: 将执行验证数据从1%扩展到100%、动作专家从64M扩展到911M参数时，四种模态均取得一致提升，并表明数据质量和跨模态监督能改善生成与执行。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出大规模执行验证的人形运动数据集与统一多模态流匹配架构，实现从多种条件直接生成运动并支持实时闭环人形控制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为人形机器人运动基础模型的数据规模化、多模态联合学习与实时闭环执行提供了重要路径。

papers.title: Aligning MLLMs with the Latent Structure of Human Cognition via Behavior-Derived Semantic Dimensions
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations and decision criteria align with the latent structure of human cognition. In this work, we propose a novel framework to align MLLMs with the multidimensional mental representations underlying human similarity judgements. We build on a previously established behavior-derived semantic embedding space, in which objects are represented along 66 interpretable dimensions derived from 4.70 million human Odd-One-Out (O1O) judgements. For each triplet, we infer the most salient decision dimension and convert it into a dimension-grounded linguistic rationale. This enables MLLMs to learn both the final choice and a justification consistent with the inferred behavioral criterion. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves model consistency with human similarity judgements while retaining competitive performance on standard multimodal benchmarks. Furthermore, using searchlight Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) on an independent fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), we observe increased representational alignment between model and human. Ultimately, our findings point to a data-driven route for incorporating human cognitive structure into MLLMs alignment. The code is available \href{https://github.com/ening-open/cogalign}{here}.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）的内部表征与决策标准是否与人类认知的潜在结构对齐尚不明确，本文旨在让MLLMs对齐人类相似性判断背后的多维心理表征。
ai_summary.method: 基于由470万次人类Odd-One-Out判断构建的66维行为衍生语义嵌入空间，对每个三元组推断最显著的决策维度，并转化为维度接地的语言理由，使MLLMs同时学习最终选择与符合人类行为标准的解释。
ai_summary.result: 该方法提升了模型与人类相似性判断的一致性，同时在标准多模态基准上保持有竞争力表现；在独立fMRI自然场景数据集上的searchlight RSA显示模型与人类表征对齐增强。
ai_summary.novelty: 利用行为衍生、可解释的语义维度将人类认知结构显式注入MLLMs的决策与解释学习，并用fMRI表征相似性分析验证对齐效果。
ai_summary.relevance: 为将人类认知结构数据驱动地融入多模态大模型对齐提供了新路径，并连接了行为语义、模型可解释性与神经表征对齐研究。

papers.title: SketchMate: Agentic Geometric Reasoning for Zero-Shot Precision Insertion
papers.abstract: Inserting an unseen part requires sub-millimetre precision and the correct orientation of keyed features. Current zero-shot agentic manipulation methods built on vision-language models (VLMs) produce spatial outputs that are far too coarse for this. We propose to let a VLM build a sketch model of the task, i.e., a few geometric primitives and two mate frames, which a VLM agent measures with geometric tools in multi-view depth and which a standard planner and compliant controller execute. Because a sketch describes the parts independently of their placement, the robot needs to build it only once per task. A sketch memory stores each agent run and transfers the stored sketch to later placements by point-cloud registration, so that the VLM is called only for unfamiliar parts. After grasping the part, the robot inspects both mating faces at close range and corrects the sketch by shape matching. On 69 simulated insertion episodes, our method inserts 88% of the parts at the assembled pose in a strict kinematic test, while ReKep and MOKA with the same VLM insert none. On new placements of eight tasks, reusing one stored run inserts as many parts as calling the agent in each episode, and it produces the sketch in 3.4 s instead of about 90 s.

ai_summary.problem: 现有基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的零样本具身操作方法输出的空间信息过于粗糙，难以满足未见零件插入所需的亚毫米级精度与键控特征正确朝向。
ai_summary.method: 让 VLM 构建任务的“草图模型”，即若干几何基元与两个配合坐标系，再由 VLM 智能体在多视角深度图中用几何工具测量这些几何要素，并交由标准规划器与柔顺控制器执行。由于草图描述了零件本身的几何而与具体摆放位置无关，每个任务只需构建一次；草图记忆通过点云配准把已存草图迁移到新位姿，抓取后再近距离检查两个配合面并用形状匹配修正草图，从而只对陌生物体调用 VLM。
ai_summary.result: 在 69 个仿真插入回合的严格运动学测试中，该方法以装配姿态成功插入 88% 的零件，而使用同一 VLM 的 ReKep 与 MOKA 均无一成功；在八个任务的新摆放位置上，复用一次存储的草图与逐回合调用智能体插入数量相当，且草图生成时间从约 90 秒降至 3.4 秒。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出用 VLM 生成可复用的几何草图模型（几何基元 + 配合坐标系），并以多视角深度测量、点云配准复用与近距离形状匹配修正，把 VLM 的粗粒度空间输出转化为亚毫米级插入精度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLM 驱动的具身智能提供了一条“语义理解 + 几何精化”的可行路径，显著提升了零样本精密装配的可靠性与效率，对机器人操作与世界模型中的几何推理研究有借鉴意义。

papers.title: Open-Weight MLLMs Cannot Compare What They Cannot Name
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly capable of understanding images and performing complex visual reasoning, suggesting the possibility of using them to automate biological image analysis. This need is becoming increasingly urgent as advances in technology continue to generate ever larger and more diverse microscopy datasets, already exceeding the scale at which manual visual analysis is feasible. With the final aim to use MLLMs for visual comparison of complex phenotypes, we investigate a very simple baseline: comparison of the size of body parts in synthetic images of ants. We find that state-of-the-art open-weight MLLMs fail for some body parts, but not for others, even though the comparison itself is visually trivial for all of them. We evaluate different in-context learning strategies and analyze performance on the related object recognition task. Our results suggest a recognition-driven grounding failure: structures that the models cannot recognize are instead associated with a recognizable semantic concept, impairing the grounding and comparison of both. Further analysis of the vision encoder is consistent with the hypothesis that fine-grained visual structure may be less well preserved without semantic support. Together, our results reveal a surprising limitation of current MLLMs: semantic recognition can gate simple visual comparisons that do not intrinsically require semantic understanding. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/kreshuklab/Open-Weight-MLLMs-Cannot-Compare-What-They-Cannot-Name

ai_summary.problem: 论文探究开放权重多模态大模型能否可靠完成简单的视觉比较任务，以及为何在部分身体部位的大小比较上失败。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建合成蚂蚁图像上的身体部位大小比较基准，评测当前先进开放权重 MLLM，并比较不同上下文学习策略、相关物体识别任务及视觉编码器表现。
ai_summary.result: 模型对某些身体部位的大小比较失败，尽管任务视觉上很简单；结果表明存在识别驱动的 grounding 失败，无法识别的结构会被关联到可识别的语义概念，从而损害 grounding 与比较。
ai_summary.novelty: 揭示了语义识别会门控本不需要语义理解的简单视觉比较，即模型“叫不出名字就比较不了”。
ai_summary.relevance: 对多模态大模型的视觉 grounding、细粒度感知及生物图像自动化分析具有重要警示意义。

papers.title: WorkIng: A Real-World and Synthetic Highway Work-Zone Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Navigation
papers.abstract: Highway work zones are critical edge cases for autonomous vehicles (AVs), combining atypical geometries and jurisdiction-specific regulations that existing benchmarks fail to capture: real-world datasets lack 360° multi-modal, full-scene 3D work zone annotation, and no single recorded site can span the layouts and regulatory variants needed for generalizable models. We present WorkIng, a dual-domain benchmark and training resource. WorkIng-Highway provides a 360° multi-modal work zone benchmark with synchronized 128-channel LiDAR, six RGB cameras, and RTK-GPS across 32 km, yielding 12,000+ annotated frames and 227,399 tracked 3D bounding boxes. WorkIng-CARLA complements this with procedural simulation spanning 24 regulation-aware scenarios across six canonical topologies and six international traffic standards, populated by 100+ custom 3D assets. Benchmarking representative 3D detection and end-to-end planning architectures shows that real-world data remains the primary performance driver, and that scenario-stratified synthetic augmentation improves architectures across 2D recognition, 3D detection, and trajectory planning. Resources: https://github.com/cvims/WorkIng

ai_summary.problem: 高速公路施工区是自动驾驶的关键长尾场景，现有基准缺乏360°多模态、全场景3D施工区标注，且单一真实场地难以覆盖不同布局和法规变体。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出WorkIng双域基准：WorkIng-Highway提供32 km真实道路的360°多模态数据（128线LiDAR、6路RGB相机、RTK-GPS），含12,000+标注帧和227,399个3D框；WorkIng-CARLA提供覆盖6种典型拓扑、6种国际交通标准和24个法规感知场景的程序化仿真数据。
ai_summary.result: 对代表性3D检测和端到端规划架构的评测表明，真实数据仍是性能主要驱动因素，而按场景分层的合成数据增强可提升2D识别、3D检测和轨迹规划性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了真实与仿真互补、带法规感知场景且支持360°多模态全场景3D标注的高速公路施工区基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 为自动驾驶在施工区等安全关键长尾场景中的感知与规划研究提供了标准化评测和合成数据增强资源。

papers.title: Multimodal In-Context Learning with Explicit Rule Induction
papers.abstract: A central challenge in multimodal in-context learning (MICL) arises from tasks that are ill-defined without context and require uncovering the underlying rules from demonstrations. Existing methods predominantly treat MICL as direct input-output mapping, overlooking the importance of explicitly inducing and reasoning over such rules, limiting both performance and interpretability. We propose ERIM, Explicit Rule-Induction for Multimodal In-Context Learning, a unified framework that enhances MICL by explicitly inducing the latent rules governing demonstration samples. Leveraging the reasoning ability of multi-modal large language model (MLLM), ERIM constructs rule-centric MICL datasets, introduces explicit supervision for rule induction, and fine-tunes MLLM to perform explicit rule-induction via a two-stage training strategy that combines mixed cold-start supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments show consistent performance improvements across diverse MICL settings and demonstrate that correctly inducing underlying rules directly leads to stronger and more stable performance.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态上下文学习（MICL）中许多任务在无上下文时定义不清，需要从示例中推断潜在规则；现有方法多将MICL视为直接输入输出映射，忽视显式规则归纳与推理，限制性能和可解释性。
ai_summary.method: 提出ERIM框架，利用多模态大语言模型的推理能力构建以规则为中心的MICL数据集，引入规则归纳的显式监督，并采用混合冷启动监督微调与强化学习的两阶段策略微调MLLM，使其显式进行规则归纳。
ai_summary.result: 在多种MICL设置下取得一致的性能提升，并表明正确归纳潜在规则能直接带来更强、更稳定的表现。
ai_summary.novelty: 将显式规则归纳引入多模态上下文学习，并配套规则中心数据集、显式监督和两阶段训练框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于提升多模态上下文学习的性能、稳定性和可解释性，推动MLLM在需要规则推理的任务中的应用。
ai_summary.org: 同济大学（Cairong Zhao）等

papers.title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication
papers.abstract: Bridging independent vision-language models (VLMs) and small language models (SLMs) in a modular multi-agent system typically forces them to exchange information as discrete text, which creates a lossy bottleneck for spatial and fine-grained details. This constraint is especially acute for SLMs, whose limited capacity makes them more reliant on the quality of the input signal. Recent latent-communication methods exchange states between language models. How a VLM can pass visual information to a separately pretrained text-only SLM though remains unexplored. We propose \textbf{Latent-Lens}, a lightweight codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM directly in latent space, enabling them to communicate purely through hidden states. The codec consists of a domain encoder that projects hidden states from the VLM into the SLM's embedding space, and an attention decoder formalised as a LoRA that teaches the SLM to attend to these visual prefixes, while training only ${\sim}1.6$M parameters (0.2\% of the combined model size). On visual question answering (CLEVR, GQA), Latent-Lens achieves $81.0\pm7.9$\% and $65.4\pm5.4$\%, compared with $58.3\pm5.7$\% and $61.8\pm1.0$\% for text communication with the same LoRA budget (+30.2--69.8pp relative to frozen text communication), while on image captioning (Flickr8k) it improves over the same baseline by +16.5 (+18.8 frozen). We also evaluate Latent-Lens with TinyLlama-1.1B and InternVL2-1B, which use different architectures, vocabularies, and hidden dimensions.

ai_summary.problem: 在模块化多智能体系统中，独立视觉语言模型（VLM）与小语言模型（SLM）通常只能通过离散文本交换信息，造成空间与细粒度信息的有损瓶颈；对容量有限的SLM尤其严重。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Latent-Lens，一个轻量级编解码器，在冻结VLM与冻结SLM之间直接以潜在空间通信。它包含将VLM隐藏状态投影到SLM嵌入空间的域编码器，以及形式化为LoRA的注意力解码器，让SLM学会关注视觉前缀；仅训练约1.6M参数（总模型规模的0.2%）。
ai_summary.result: 在CLEVR和GQA上分别达到81.0±7.9%和65.4±5.4%，显著优于同LoRA预算的文本通信（58.3±5.7%和61.8±1.0%）；在Flickr8k图像描述上相对同基线提升+16.5（冻结基线+18.8），并在TinyLlama-1.1B与InternVL2-1B上验证了跨架构适用性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次实现冻结VLM向单独预训练的纯文本SLM进行纯潜在空间视觉信息传递，并以极小参数量桥接表示鸿沟。
ai_summary.relevance: 为高效、模块化的多模态智能体提供了一条避免文本瓶颈的潜在通信路径，对SLM增强视觉感知和多模型协同具有启发意义。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（Mathew Salvaris 等作者可能来自 Microsoft，但摘要无法确认）

papers.title: When Depth Lies: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Mirror-Induced RGB-D Ambiguity
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made significant progress in spatial reasoning, particularly by integrating RGB images with depth data, which is often assumed to faithfully reflect physical distances. However, mirrors violate this assumption: they distort depth readings while reproducing object appearances, making reflections difficult to distinguish from real objects. As existing benchmarks rarely consider such reflective scenarios, VLM performance in mirror scenes remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce a mirror-centric RGB-D dataset from reflective scenes to evaluate the spatial reasoning capabilities of state-of-the-art VLMs in these scenarios. Specifically, we collect 1,011 RGB-D images from 525 real-world scenes, spanning diverse indoor and outdoor environments, six reflective surface types, and both daytime and nighttime conditions. All images are annotated with reflective surface region masks and mask annotations for both directly observed and mirror-reflected objects. Then, we curate a benchmark named MIRA-Bench (Mirror-Induced Reasoning Ambiguity Benchmark), comprising 14,140 QA pairs across eight sub-tasks organized into three cognitive levels: Reflection-aware Perception, Spatial Reasoning, and Scene-level Decision-making. We evaluate state-of-the-art VLMs on MIRA-Bench and find consistent failures across tasks: models misclassify whether objects are directly observed or reflected, fail to match reflected instances to their real-world counterparts, and produce erroneous spatial inferences. Remarkably, providing depth data actually degrades reasoning performance, implying that VLMs cannot identify incorrect depth in mirror scenes. The code and data are available at https://github.com/EvaYin-cloud/MIRA-Bench

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间推理通常假设深度数据能忠实反映物理距离，但镜面会扭曲深度读数却保留物体外观，导致反射物与真实物难以区分；而现有基准几乎不考虑这类反射场景，VLM在镜面场景下的表现尚不清楚。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了一个以镜面为核心的RGB-D数据集，采集自525个真实场景的1,011张RGB-D图像，覆盖室内外、六类反射表面以及昼夜条件，并标注了反射面区域掩码与直接观测/镜面反射物体的掩码。在此基础上提出MIRA-Bench基准，包含8个子任务、共14,140个QA对，按反射感知、空间推理、场景级决策三个认知层级组织，并系统评测了当前先进VLM。
ai_summary.result: 评测显示VLM在各任务上一致失败：无法判断物体是直接观测还是反射、无法将反射实例与真实物体对应、并产生错误的空间推断；尤其值得注意的是，额外提供深度数据反而降低了推理性能，说明模型无法识别镜面场景中错误的深度信息。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地揭示并基准化“镜面导致的RGB-D歧义”问题，指出深度先验在反射场景下可能有害，填补了多模态空间推理评测的空白。
ai_summary.relevance: 提醒多模态社区不能盲目信任深度输入，为构建具备物理常识与反射感知能力的鲁棒空间推理模型提供了关键评测工具与方向。
ai_summary.org: 未能从提供的信息中确定（作者机构字段为空）

papers.title: Direct Action-Manifold Modeling for Efficient and Robust Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract: Diffusion and flow matching visuomotor policies require iterative denoising or numerical integration for multimodal action generation, introducing latency and execution mismatch. We instead consider a different formulation: conditioned on vision and proprioception, demonstrated bimanual action chunks concentrate in a structured observation-dependent region of joint-action space, making the action target more direct to model than the generative process. Based on this view, we propose the Direct Manifold Action Transformer (DMAT), which reformulates action generation as the direct modeling of clean, observation-conditioned joint-space action chunks from stochastic interpolants, thereby enabling single-step inference without relying on iterative generative inference or auxiliary trajectory-straightening procedures. Within DMAT, local 3D geometry anchors predictions to spatial structure, while State-Consistent Spectral-Time Refinement (STR) reconciles predicted chunks with proprioception and suppresses high-frequency residuals. Across 567 standard and out-of-distribution (OOD) trials per method, DMAT outperformed Improved 3D Diffusion Policy (IDP3) and DiTFlow3D in aggregate success rate, achieving relative improvements of 129.1% and 95.7%, respectively, while generating action chunks 2.06x and 1.34x faster and remaining robust under repeated 50 N interventions. These results pave the way for a novel generative paradigm for efficient and robust bimanual manipulation.

ai_summary.problem: 扩散/流匹配视觉运动策略需要迭代去噪或数值积分，导致多模态动作生成延迟高且执行不匹配，尤其影响双臂操作的效率与鲁棒性。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Direct Manifold Action Transformer (DMAT)，将动作生成重构为直接从随机插值中建模观测条件下的干净关节空间动作块，实现单步推理；并用局部3D几何锚定空间结构，用 State-Consistent Spectral-Time Refinement (STR) 对齐本体感知并抑制高频残差。
ai_summary.result: 在每种方法567次标准与分布外试验中，DMAT总体成功率相对 IDP3 和 DiTFlow3D 分别提升129.1%和95.7%，动作块生成速度分别快2.06倍和1.34倍，并在重复50 N干预下保持鲁棒。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将动作生成从迭代生成过程转为直接建模观测条件下的动作流形，从而无需迭代推理或辅助轨迹拉直即可单步生成双臂动作块。
ai_summary.relevance: 为高效、鲁棒的双臂视觉运动策略提供了一种新的生成范式，可能推动机器人操作中低延迟动作生成与部署。
ai_summary.org: 未能从提供信息中确认；根据作者信息推测可能来自同济大学

papers.title: GRIT: Gradient Masking for Visually Misgrounded Tokens in Text-Rich Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently been extended to vision-language models (VLMs), yet its effectiveness remains limited for text-rich reasoning tasks. We highlight a key factor contributing to this limitation: models frequently arrive at correct final answers despite misperceiving visual information during intermediate steps. We define this phenomenon as Correct-but-Visually-Misgrounded Reasoning (CVMR). Because standard RLVR rewards only final-answer correctness, it fails to differentiate between properly grounded and misgrounded reasoning, reinforcing both equally. Through token-level analysis, we reveal that CVMR tokens exhibit distinct attention patterns that differ systematically from well-grounded ones. Based on this observation, we propose GRIT, a training framework that incorporates visual grounding into RLVR to mitigate the impact of CVMR. Furthermore, to address the lack of text-rich reasoning benchmarks that allow for systematic evaluation across text length and reasoning depth, we introduce GRIT-Bench. Experiments demonstrate that GRIT significantly improves both reasoning accuracy and grounding fidelity over existing RLVR methods.

ai_summary.problem: 现有RLVR在视觉语言模型的文本丰富推理任务中效果有限，论文指出模型常在中间步骤误读视觉信息却仍得到正确答案，即“正确但视觉依据错误”的推理（CVMR）。
ai_summary.method: 作者通过token级分析发现CVMR token具有系统性不同的注意力模式，并提出GRIT训练框架，将视觉 grounding 融入RLVR，对视觉误 grounding 的 token 进行梯度掩码；同时构建GRIT-Bench以系统评估文本长度和推理深度下的文本丰富推理。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明GRIT在推理准确率和视觉 grounding 保真度上均显著优于现有RLVR方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 识别并形式化CVMR现象，并利用token级注意力差异设计梯度掩码机制，将视觉 grounding 监督引入RLVR。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在文本丰富场景中的可信推理与视觉 grounding 对齐提供了新思路和评测基准。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未在提供信息中明确列出，推测主要来自韩国首尔市立大学（University of Seoul）。

papers.title: Attention Maps Know When to Think: Training-Free Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought for Reasoning Segmentation
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become a standard reasoning strategy in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), showing strong performance in complex vision-language tasks such as reasoning segmentation. However, our analysis reveals that indiscriminate CoT usage can lead to degraded performance by inducing unnecessary reasoning, a phenomenon we term overthinking. In reasoning segmentation, overthinking often leads to misalignment between the query's intent and visual grounding. To address this, we propose Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (DA-CoT), a training-free adaptive framework that selectively triggers CoT based on the input's intrinsic difficulty. We find that the entropy of the model's attention maps reliably reflects task difficulty: low entropy indicates confident, localized grounding, while high entropy suggests uncertainty and potential benefit from CoT. DA-CoT uses this entropy signal to determine whether to apply CoT prompting. Additionally, we introduce a Bidirectional Rethinking mechanism that enables the model to automatically flip its reasoning decision when the initial output fails, enhancing robustness by recovering from failures induced by overthinking and underthinking. DA-CoT demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Reasoning Segmentation benchmarks while significantly improving inference efficiency.

ai_summary.problem: 推理分割中无差别使用Chain-of-Thought会引发“过度思考”，导致查询意图与视觉定位错位并降低性能。
ai_summary.method: 提出免训练的Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought框架，利用模型注意力图熵值判断输入难度，自适应决定是否触发CoT；并引入Bidirectional Rethinking机制，在初次输出失败时自动翻转推理决策以提升鲁棒性。
ai_summary.result: 在Reasoning Segmentation基准上取得最优性能，同时显著提升推理效率。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次发现注意力图熵可可靠反映推理分割任务难度，并据此实现免训练的自适应CoT触发与双向重思。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型中的自适应推理提供简单有效的训练-free思路，有助于减少过度思考并提升推理效率。
ai_summary.org: University of Seoul

papers.title: VLA Policies Do Not Know When Not to Act: Unintended Task Execution and Start Suppression
papers.abstract: A robot should act only on an instruction from a person or on an intent that the robot explicitly represents and generates. Unintended actions taken without such an instruction can cause risk or inconvenience to people and the environment. We examine how recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies respond when the instruction is missing or meaningless. We apply a paired protocol with empty, neutral, nonsense, infeasible, and wrong-task instructions to six model checkpoints in LIBERO-Goal simulation. Holding the initial state fixed and varying only the instruction, we ask three questions: whether the robot starts to move, which task it completes, and what the instruction determines. Even when the instruction was empty, the robot started moving in every episode with all six checkpoints, and with five of them it often completed a task that the instruction had not specified. On two GR00T checkpoints, the instruction determined which task was executed but not whether the robot started moving; the robot moved even on infeasible instructions. We then tested three methods for suppressing the start: prepending "if no task is given do not move" to the instruction; a gate that holds the robot when the first action chunk for the given instruction nearly equals that for an empty instruction; and fine-tuning the policy to hold still on non-task inputs. The prefix stopped the robot in none of the six checkpoints, and the gate held it on non-task inputs in five of the six checkpoints. The fine-tuned policy never completed a task on non-task inputs, but it did not reliably keep the robot still, and it failed to suppress the start on infeasible instructions.

ai_summary.problem: 当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在指令缺失或无意义时仍会执行动作，可能带来安全风险；论文要回答这类策略是否会“擅自启动”，以及能否抑制这种非预期执行。
ai_summary.method: 在 LIBERO-Goal 仿真中对 6 个模型检查点采用配对实验协议：固定初始状态，仅改变指令（空、中性、无意义、不可行、错误任务），考察是否启动、完成何任务、指令决定了什么；并测试三种抑制启动的方法——在指令前加“若无任务则不要动”的前缀、比较当前指令与空指令首个动作块是否近似相等的门控、以及微调策略使其在非任务输入下保持静止。
ai_summary.result: 所有 6 个检查点在空指令下每回合都会启动，其中 5 个常完成未被指定的任务；两个 GR00T 检查点上指令只决定执行哪个任务、不决定是否启动，甚至不可行指令也会动。前缀法在 6 个检查点上均无效，门控在 5/6 上能抑制非任务输入，微调虽未在非任务输入上完成任务但无法可靠保持静止，且对不可行指令失效。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统刻画 VLA 策略缺乏“何时不该行动”的能力，并用配对指令协议量化对比了提示、门控与微调三类启动抑制方案的有效性边界。
ai_summary.relevance: 揭示了具身 VLA 模型在指令条件化与动作门控上的关键安全缺口，为构建可靠可拒答的机器人策略提供了评测范式与改进方向。
ai_summary.org: 未在提供信息中给出作者机构（作者为 Minsu Jang、Jae-Woo Choi、Youngwoo Yoon、Dohyung Kim，机构字段为空）

papers.title: Sensorium: An Open-Source Multimodal Data Collection and Curation Library for Embodied Surgical AI
papers.abstract: Embodied surgical AI requires reliable multimodal data, yet surgical data collection remains costly, difficult to repeat, and strongly dependent on the hardware setup. We present Sensorium, an open-source Python library for recording, processing, annotating, and curating multimodal surgical data from configurable robot and sensor streams using the Robot Operating System (ROS) and ROS2 middleware. The library combines operator-facing data acquisition, configurable processing, semantic annotation, and episodic dataset generation. We evaluate Sensorium across 1516 recordings of phantom, ex vivo, and in vivo porcine experiments involving multiple surgical tasks and sensing configurations, and report preliminary usability feedback.

ai_summary.problem: 具身手术AI需要可靠的多模态数据，但手术数据采集成本高、难以重复且高度依赖硬件配置。
ai_summary.method: 提出开源Python库Sensorium，基于ROS/ROS2中间件，从可配置的机器人和传感器流中完成数据记录、处理、语义标注与 episodic 数据集生成。
ai_summary.result: 在1516次体模、离体和活体猪实验录制中验证，覆盖多种手术任务和传感配置，并报告初步可用性反馈。
ai_summary.novelty: 提供一个面向具身手术AI的端到端、开源、可配置的多模态数据采集与整理工具库。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于降低手术机器人与多模态AI研究中的数据采集和数据集构建门槛，促进可复现研究。
ai_summary.org: 未能从提供信息中确定；作者包含Stefanie Speidel，可能来自德国德累斯顿相关机构。

papers.title: Nereus: A Large-Scale Underwater Dataset for Fine-Grained Attribute Understanding and Grounded Counting Perception
papers.abstract: Underwater imagery records rich ecological information and supports applications such as science communication, fishery monitoring, ecological conservation, and oceanographic research. Beyond general scene understanding, these applications require models to recognize fine-grained biological traits and reason over spatially grounded evidence. However, existing underwater datasets often provide coarse category labels, generic captions, or total-count supervision, which limits their use for organism-level analysis and ecological reasoning. We introduce Nereus, a large-scale dataset for Underwater Fine-grained Perception that jointly supports Fine-Grained Object Attribute Understanding and Grounded Counting Perception. Nereus contains 88K images and 2.68M question-answer pairs, including annotations for 136K marine organism objects across 2,690 species and 1,515 genera, as well as 65K point annotations and 67K grounded counting QA pairs. Experiments with representative multimodal models show that Nereus improves downstream adaptation over existing underwater-domain data and provides a foundation for future research on fine-grained marine perception.

ai_summary.problem: 现有水下图像数据集通常只提供粗粒度类别标签、通用描述或整体计数监督，无法支撑生物个体级别的细粒度属性理解与空间定位计数推理。
ai_summary.method: 构建了大规模水下细粒度感知数据集 Nereus，包含8.8万张图像、268万问答对，标注13.6万个海洋生物个体（覆盖2690个物种、1515个属），并提供6.5万点标注和6.7万基于定位的计数问答对，联合支持细粒度属性理解与定位计数任务。
ai_summary.result: 在多模态模型上的实验表明，使用 Nereus 进行下游适配优于现有水下领域数据，为细粒度海洋感知研究提供了基础资源。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将细粒度物种属性理解与基于空间定位的计数感知统一到一个大规模水下数据集中，并提供个体级点标注与 grounding 计数问答。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在细粒度视觉属性理解、定位计数与领域适配方面提供了新的评测与训练基准，推动了具身/生态感知等应用。
ai_summary.org: 未知（作者机构信息未提供）

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Transformer Encoders for Audio-Image-Symbolic Music Retrieval
papers.abstract: Score-based multimodal music retrieval requires representations that are both discriminative within each modality and compatible across audio recordings, sheet music images, and symbolic scores. This paper investigates the effectiveness of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for adapting pretrained music encoders and examines whether modality-specific improvements translate into better multimodal representations. We compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, and QLoRA across nine pretrained audio, image, and symbolic score encoders on TriScore and the Musical Theme Dataset. Encoders are first evaluated and selected through supervised unimodal classification, using frozen-encoder linear probing as a reference. We then introduce a controlled 2x2 design crossing encoder adaptation with task-specific shared projection, comparing frozen and adapted representations before and after projection. LoRA or QLoRA is selected in 14 of 18 modality-target combinations, frequently matching or outperforming full fine-tuning while optimizing substantially fewer parameters. However, these unimodal gains do not transfer uniformly to multimodal classification. Adaptation and projection are complementary for composer classification on TriScore, largely redundant for TriScore instrument and the Musical Theme Dataset instrument and ensemble tasks, and partially interfering for composer classification on the Musical Theme Dataset. The final adapted-and-projected title representation on TriScore supports piece-level retrieval, reaching average Top-5 and Top-10 accuracies of 55.32 and 64.68, respectively. Cross-modal exclusion and neighborhood analyses further reveal strong modality-specific local structure in the projected spaces. Overall, PEFT provides an effective and computationally efficient alternative to full fine-tuning, but improved unimodal discrimination alone does not guarantee better multimodal organization.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究参数高效微调（PEFT）能否有效适配预训练音乐编码器，以及单模态分类上的提升是否能转化为音频、乐谱图像和符号乐谱之间的更好多模态音乐检索表示。
ai_summary.method: 在 TriScore 和 Musical Theme Dataset 上，对 9 个预训练音频、图像和符号乐谱编码器比较全量微调、LoRA 和 QLoRA；先用冻结编码器线性探测作参考进行单模态分类评估与选择，再用 2x2 受控设计交叉考察编码器适配与任务特定共享投影，比较投影前后的冻结/适配表示。
ai_summary.result: LoRA 或 QLoRA 在 18 个模态-目标任务组合中有 14 个被选中，常以更少参数匹配或超过全量微调；但单模态收益并不能均匀迁移到多模态分类，适配与投影在 TriScore 作曲家分类上互补、在部分任务上冗余或部分干扰；最终 TriScore 标题表示取得 Top-5 55.32、Top-10 64.68 的平均检索准确率。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统性地解耦并评估 PEFT 编码器适配与共享投影对多模态音乐表示的影响，揭示单模态判别力提升不必然带来更好的跨模态组织。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态音乐检索提供高效的预训练编码器适配方案，同时提醒多模态系统评估不能仅依赖单模态指标。
ai_summary.org: 阿利坎特大学（University of Alicante，根据作者推断）

papers.title: Automated Keyword Generation Using LLMs in a High-Volume Data Virtualization Service
papers.abstract: In modern data infrastructure, a data virtualization service (DVS) allows users to create many versions of source datasets for different processing tasks. For example, a multivariate or multi-modality dataset can be used for different machine learning tasks (e.g., classification, detection, segmentation, forecasting, and so on). Data selection, participation, integration, and preprocessing in different tasks result in many virtual datasets [Khan et al., SSC 2026]. Meanwhile, different users need to discover existing virtual datasets frequently and easily to avoid duplicate efforts. To enable an effective search engine in a DVS, it is desirable to automatically generate keywords for each virtual dataset. In this work, we present a solution for generating keywords for virtual datasets using large language models (LLMs). We propose five strategies for selecting different collections of text data for processing by the LLMs. We applied the five strategies to virtual datasets created in five application case studies with different source datasets. We conducted experiments with three LLM generators and two embedding techniques. The experiments show that the performances of the five strategies depend on the quality of the text descriptions. The results help us adopt a multi-strategy implementation of a new keyword generation service (KGS) as part of an extended DVS. The work demonstrates that the capability of automated keyword generation is indispensable for a high-volume DVS that is dataset-rich and frequently accessed.

ai_summary.problem: 在高容量数据虚拟化服务（DVS）中，虚拟数据集数量庞大且用户需频繁发现已有数据集，若缺乏有效关键词，搜索和维护都会很困难。本文旨在为每个虚拟数据集自动生成关键词，以支撑可用的搜索引擎。
ai_summary.method: 作者利用大语言模型（LLM）为虚拟数据集生成关键词，提出五种挑选输入文本集合的策略，并在五个不同源数据集的应用案例中实施。实验覆盖三种LLM生成器和两种嵌入技术，对比各策略的关键词生成效果。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明，五种策略的性能主要取决于文本描述的质量；据此，作者在扩展的DVS中采用多策略组合的关键词生成服务（KGS）。该工作说明，自动关键词生成对数据集丰富、访问频繁的高容量DVS不可或缺。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统比较多种LLM输入文本选取策略，用于数据虚拟化服务中的关键词自动生成，并落地为多策略KGS服务。
ai_summary.relevance: 为数据管理与LLM结合提供实践范例，有助于构建可检索、可复用的数据集基础设施，支撑多模态与多任务数据的高效发现。

papers.title: TopoHyperClinicalGraph: A Geometry and Topology-Aware Multimodal Framework for Cancer Survival Prediction
papers.abstract: We developed TopoHyperClinicalGraph, a multimodal framework combining hyperbolic tissue geometry, persistent topology and clinical graph learning for cancer survival prediction. Pre-extracted UNI2-h features are reduced from 1,536 to 1,024 dimensions using training-fold PCA. A pathology backbone combines hyperbolic neighborhoods with Lorentz-centroid attention pooling. Once frozen, its survival logits are adjusted using persistence descriptors from up to 64 landmarks per slide and sampling controls. A five-node clinical graph then learns a further correction from age, sex, stage, T and N.   Five-fold patient-level evaluation covered eight TCGA and CPTAC cohorts with 2,364 patients. Mean validation-selected C-indices for TopoHyperClinicalGraph versus pathology-only spatial PatchGCN were 0.7563 versus 0.7386 in COADREAD, 0.6220 versus 0.5998 in HNSC, 0.6755 versus 0.6535 in BRCA and 0.6409 versus 0.6176 in STAD. CPTAC scores were 0.5984 in HNSC, 0.6060 in PDA, 0.8055 in CCRCC and 0.7192 in LUAD. CPTAC-HNSC used TCGA-initialized adaptation; other CPTAC backbones were trained within their cohorts. Geometry accounted for most pathology-only gains, with smaller persistence effects. Clinical graph fusion exceeded its matched node-wise control in five cohorts, tied in one and scored lower in two; clinical-only prediction exceeded fusion in three CPTAC cohorts.   The framework supports separate evaluation of geometric, topological and clinical contributions. All scores were validation-selected; independent testing is needed to establish generalizability.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文旨在解决癌症生存预测中如何融合病理组织几何、持续拓扑特征与临床图信息的问题，并支持分别评估几何、拓扑和临床模块的贡献。
ai_summary.method: 方法先用训练折PCA将UNI2-h病理特征从1536维降到1024维，病理主干结合双曲邻域与Lorentz质心注意力池化；冻结生存logits后，用每张切片最多64个landmark的持续拓扑描述符进行校正；最后用五节点临床图从年龄、性别、分期、T和N学习进一步校正。
ai_summary.result: 在8个TCGA/CPTAC队列、2364例患者上做五折患者级评估，多个队列C-index优于仅病理PatchGCN，例如COADREAD 0.7563 vs 0.7386、BRCA 0.6755 vs 0.6535；几何贡献最大，拓扑较小，临床图融合效果不一致，且所有分数均为验证集选择，需独立测试验证泛化性。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于将双曲组织几何、持续拓扑与临床图学习组合为可分解评估的多模态癌症生存预测框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 对计算病理和多模态生存分析有一定参考价值，但当前证据仍属验证集选择结果，独立泛化验证不足。

key_lab_papers.title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
key_lab_papers.abstract: Planning with world models enables test-time adaptation for embodied agents, offering superior generalization over direct policy learning. However, long-horizon tasks remain hindered by cumulative errors and search complexity. Existing hierarchical methods often use rigid macro-actions or latent skills, leading to brittle representations and limited fine-grained control. We introduce ID-WM (Implicit Dynamics World Models), a hierarchical world model that decouples state-space reachability from local control. Our framework utilizes a high-level model to sample feasible transitions across the state manifold and a low-level world model as an inverse dynamics solver to ground these transitions into precise actions. This allows the planner to identify reachable subgoals without being constrained by low-level execution details. By prioritizing local physical feasibility over global behavioral patterns, ID-WM synthesizes novel long-horizon plans from short segments, transcending the specific behavioral modes seen during training. We demonstrate its effectiveness across three navigation and manipulation suites, achieving a 38.5% improvement over state-of-the-art policy and diffusion-based planners. Crucially, by leveraging this hierarchical structure to mitigate compounding errors, our approach yields a 135% performance gain over single-level world model MPC, particularly in complex, unseen configurations for long-horizon tasks. Videos can be viewed at https://id-wm.github.io

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型规划在长时程任务中受累积误差和搜索复杂度限制，现有分层方法使用刚性宏动作或潜在技能，导致表示脆弱且缺乏细粒度控制。
ai_summary.method: 提出ID-WM分层世界模型，将状态空间可达性与局部控制解耦：高层模型采样状态流形上的可行转移，低层世界模型作为逆动力学求解器将转移落地为精确动作，使规划器不受低层执行细节约束。
ai_summary.result: 在三个导航与操作套件上比SOTA策略和扩散规划器提升38.5%，相比单层世界模型MPC在复杂未见长时程配置中提升135%。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过隐式动力学解耦可达子目标与动作生成，从短片段合成新颖长时程计划并缓解复合误差。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型中的长时程分层规划与具身智能提供了更可扩展且物理可行的范式。

key_lab_papers.title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication
key_lab_papers.abstract: Bridging independent vision-language models (VLMs) and small language models (SLMs) in a modular multi-agent system typically forces them to exchange information as discrete text, which creates a lossy bottleneck for spatial and fine-grained details. This constraint is especially acute for SLMs, whose limited capacity makes them more reliant on the quality of the input signal. Recent latent-communication methods exchange states between language models. How a VLM can pass visual information to a separately pretrained text-only SLM though remains unexplored. We propose \textbf{Latent-Lens}, a lightweight codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM directly in latent space, enabling them to communicate purely through hidden states. The codec consists of a domain encoder that projects hidden states from the VLM into the SLM's embedding space, and an attention decoder formalised as a LoRA that teaches the SLM to attend to these visual prefixes, while training only ${\sim}1.6$M parameters (0.2\% of the combined model size). On visual question answering (CLEVR, GQA), Latent-Lens achieves $81.0\pm7.9$\% and $65.4\pm5.4$\%, compared with $58.3\pm5.7$\% and $61.8\pm1.0$\% for text communication with the same LoRA budget (+30.2--69.8pp relative to frozen text communication), while on image captioning (Flickr8k) it improves over the same baseline by +16.5 (+18.8 frozen). We also evaluate Latent-Lens with TinyLlama-1.1B and InternVL2-1B, which use different architectures, vocabularies, and hidden dimensions.

ai_summary.problem: 在模块化多智能体系统中，独立视觉语言模型（VLM）与小语言模型（SLM）通常只能通过离散文本交换信息，造成空间与细粒度信息的有损瓶颈；对容量有限的SLM尤其严重。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Latent-Lens，一个轻量级编解码器，在冻结VLM与冻结SLM之间直接以潜在空间通信。它包含将VLM隐藏状态投影到SLM嵌入空间的域编码器，以及形式化为LoRA的注意力解码器，让SLM学会关注视觉前缀；仅训练约1.6M参数（总模型规模的0.2%）。
ai_summary.result: 在CLEVR和GQA上分别达到81.0±7.9%和65.4±5.4%，显著优于同LoRA预算的文本通信（58.3±5.7%和61.8±1.0%）；在Flickr8k图像描述上相对同基线提升+16.5（冻结基线+18.8），并在TinyLlama-1.1B与InternVL2-1B上验证了跨架构适用性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次实现冻结VLM向单独预训练的纯文本SLM进行纯潜在空间视觉信息传递，并以极小参数量桥接表示鸿沟。
ai_summary.relevance: 为高效、模块化的多模态智能体提供了一条避免文本瓶颈的潜在通信路径，对SLM增强视觉感知和多模型协同具有启发意义。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日 20 篇论文中 17 篇聚焦多模态，主线明显转向「潜在空间」：连续潜在推理、潜在通信、隐式动力学等多项工作同时尝试摆脱离散 token 瓶颈，以缓解推理与生成之间的模态不匹配。第二条线是具身智能与世界模型中的动作生成与可控性，覆盖人形运动基座、双臂流形建模、因果动作解耦以及 VLA 的启停抑制。此外，面向真实场景的数据与基准建设（高速公路施工区、水下细粒度、手术采集）密集出现，说明多模态研究正从模型结构转向数据、评测与失效模式刻画。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: Meta 与 Microsoft 在「多模态潜在空间表示」方向重合，但属于同一篇论文（Latent-Lens）的共同署名，是合作关系而非竞争：该工作将冻结 VLM 的视觉信息以纯潜在方式传给独立预训练的纯文本小模型。Meta 的另一篇 Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics（世界模型/具身智能）在今日大厂中无同方向对手，属独占布局；与 Latent-Lens 形成「表示对齐 + 长时程规划」的互补组合。整体看，大厂今日未出现方法路线正面撞车。
daily_insight.signals: 值得关注三点：1）「潜在空间」在多模态推理、跨模型通信、世界模型动力学中同时出现，可能是下一阶段统一架构的收敛点；2）多篇论文转向能力边界与失效模式（VLA 不该行动时仍行动、镜面导致 RGB-D 深度先验有害、MLLM 无法命名即无法比较、CVMR 视觉误接地），评测正从「能不能做」转向「何时会错」；3）小模型+潜在桥接（Latent-Lens）与免训练自适应推理（注意力熵触发 CoT）暗示效率导向路线升温；4）垂直领域数据基建（施工区、水下、手术、音乐）密集发布，数据侧竞争加剧。
daily_insight.overlap_topic: 多模态潜在空间表示与视觉-语言信息传递（Latent-Lens 同一论文共同署名，属合作关系）
